_comment: Sections appended below an entity panel's generated form. Key = entity key; '*' = every entity. Their sources and actions are 'x_' names that EntityForm routes to gui/native/entity_extras.py (ExtrasMixin).

experiment.description: Add, save, delete or open the experiment's linked data.

buttons.label: Add data
buttons.description: Add an empty data row to the selected experiment; fill its cells, then press Save data.

buttons.label: Save data
buttons.description: Save the picked data row (a data type is required; reading options must be JSON).

buttons.label: Delete data
buttons.description: Delete the picked data record (asks first).

buttons.label: Open data
buttons.description: Open the picked row's file, folder or URL with the system's default handler.

experiment.title: Experiment data / links
experiment.description: The data rows linked to the selected experiment: type, storage mode, location, MIME type, checksum, reading options and details. Click a cell to edit it, then press Save data.

buttons.label: Validate setup
buttons.description: Ask the server whether the selected setup definition is valid (a name and a positive version are required).

setup.description: The result of the last validation.

project.description: Restore or delete the picked archived version.

buttons.label: Restore project to ChiSurf
buttons.description: Fetch the picked version (the latest if none is picked) from the database and replace the open ChiSurf project with it.

buttons.label: Delete archived version
buttons.description: Delete only the picked archived version from the database (asks first).

project.title: Archived versions
project.description: Every archived version of the selected project. Pick one, then restore it into ChiSurf or delete it.

*.description: Row helpers: copy and tick rows.

buttons.label: Copy row
buttons.description: Copy the selected row as tab-separated text.

buttons.label: Copy checked IDs
buttons.description: Copy the IDs of the ticked rows, one per line.

buttons.label: Invert checks
buttons.description: Tick the unticked rows and clear the ticked ones.
